title: Skull Band with Wizard Cat
description: A large green skull wearing sunglasses sits in the center on a wooden floor with its mouth open. A wizard cat with glasses stands on the skull holding a glowing staff while two skeleton musicians play a saxophone and drum beside it.
prompt: A large green skull wearing blue and red sunglasses sits in the center of a wooden floor with its mouth open showing teeth. A tall purple wizard cat with round glasses and long flowing robes stands on the skull holding a glowing spiral staff in one hand. Two skeletons in robes play a golden saxophone and a drum on either side of the skull. Swirling turquoise and purple magic energy with floating music notes and papers fills the scene under a stormy purple sky with lightning.
